title: Assembly Stats with MetaQuast
author: James E Thornton Jr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j86crze

steps.title: Create CyVerse account
steps.instruction: Click "Sign Up" on the CyVerse website to create a new account.

steps.title: Log in to CyVerse
steps.instruction: After account creation, go to https://user.cyverse.org/ and log in with your credentials.

steps.title: Open Data folder
steps.instruction: Click the "Data" button on the left navigation pane and navigate to your user folder.

steps.title: Transfer and upload contigs
steps.instruction: Copy the contig file from the HPC server to your local machine, then upload it to CyVerse.

substeps.instruction: Run `$ scp username@sftp.hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/assembly/megahit-out/final.contigs.fa .` (replace *username* with your actual username) to download *final.contigs.fa* to your local computer.
In CyVerse, click "Upload" → "Simple Upload From Desktop" and select the downloaded *final.contigs.fa* file.

steps.title: Launch MetaQuast analysis
steps.instruction: After the upload finishes, open the MetaQuast app and start the analysis.

substeps.instruction: Click the "Apps" button on the left.
Search for "MetaQuast" and click on "MetaQuast-4.3 (denovo based)".
In the "Fasta file(s)" tab, select the uploaded *final.contigs.fa* file (the only parameter that needs to change) and click "Launch Analysis".

steps.title: Retrieve MetaQuast results
steps.instruction: When the analysis completes (you will receive an email), download the report file.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the "analyses" folder in your CyVerse data storage.
Open the MetaQuast output folder and download the "report.html" file.
